title: Quantum interference between spectral bandwidth mismatched photons
summary: Two-photon interference is a cornerstone of photonic quantum technologies. However, its practical use in hybrid architectures is constrained by the need for photon indistinguishability, particularly in linewidth and the associated time scale. While narrowband filtering can improve interference visibility, it introduces significant photon loss - a critical limitation for applications. Here, we experimentally demonstrate an efficient approach to enable non-classical two-photon interference between spectral-bandwidth mismatched photons using an electro-optic time lens.
